steps.title: Find sugar cane
steps.say: Sugar cane grows next to water, on [beaches](biome:beach) and by [rivers](biome:river) and [swamps](biome:swamp). Break it to collect it.

steps.title: Dig a water line
steps.say: Dig a long, straight ditch 1 block wide and fill it with water from a [bucket](item:bucket).

steps.title: Plant both sides
steps.say: Plant sugar cane on the [dirt](item:dirt), grass or [sand](item:sand) right next to the water, on both sides.

steps.title: Let it grow
steps.say: Sugar cane grows up to 3 blocks tall, even in the dark. [Bone meal](item:bone_meal) makes it grow right away.

steps.title: Harvest it
steps.say: Break the second block up, not the bottom one. The bottom stays and grows again.

steps.title: Use it
steps.say: Craft sugar cane into [sugar](item:sugar), or 3 sugar cane into 3 [paper](item:paper) for maps and [books](item:book).
